Initially for a period up to March, extendable up to 2028 based on requirement or till the end of the project duration, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: About the Project and Institute
content_sections.text: CSIR-CFTRI, Mysuru, describes itself as a constituent National Laboratory of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR). The engagement is on behalf of the sponsoring agency of the project, which the notice does not name. The notice is dated 26.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The eligibility rules printed in the notice are: Age: candidates should not have exceeded 35 years as on the last date of receiving applications, 12.12.2026. Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 3 years for OBC, as the notice states it. Only candidates who have already acquired the essential qualification and whose results have been declared are eligible. Result awaited, final semester appeared or appearing candidates are not eligible. Where experience is prescribed, it is counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualification. Candidates who have served CSIR-CFTRI or any other CSIR lab/institute as Project Staff at any level in CSIR projects (including NMITLI projects, OLP/MLP, Contract R&D and non-CSIR funded projects) for a total of 6 years or more are not eligible. If already working in CSIR/CSIR-CFTRI, a NOC from the current PI is mandatory for applying. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.post: Project Associate – I (PAT-I), post code GAP000681, 1 position
rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc in Food Science & Technology/Food Technology/Food Science/Food Science and Nutrition/Biotechnology/Biochemistry OR B.Tech in Food Technology/Biotechnology/Food Processing & Engineering/Food Engineering
rows.desirable: Hands-on experience in protein extraction and characterization, and biochemical analysis

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The stipend is Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, on behalf of the sponsoring agency, and co-terminus with the tenure of the project or 06 years, whichever is earlier. It is initially for a short duration based on availability of funds. It may be extended or curtailed based on the conduct and performance of the incumbent and the requirement of the institute, and may be extended further on the recommendation of the Review Committee. It cannot go beyond the project tenure and expires automatically when the project tenure ends. Other terms follow the guidelines issued by CSIR or the funding agency, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate – I (PAT-I) Job Description
content_sections.text: To carry out R&D activities aligned with the project objectives.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate – I (PAT-I)
content_sections.text: Submit the online application only at https://patcell.cftri.res.in on or before 12.12.2026. Attach the certificates in support of date of birth, caste, qualification/experience etc. No other mode of application is accepted, and applications received after 12.12.2026 will not be considered. Check the official CFTRI website https://cftri.res.in/ regularly for any addendum or corrigendum. Shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview date by e-mail to the address given in the online application form. No interim enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted by a designated committee according to the current requirement, and the candidates shortlisted for interview are displayed on the CSIR-CFTRI website. With a large number of applications, the committee will adopt its own criteria to limit the number called for interview, using any one or more of these methods: Based on interview performance, the result of selected candidates against the number of posts available in the project for each post code is declared and posted on the CFTRI website. Selection for engagement, the panel of waitlisted candidates and its validity follow CSIR rules under OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024, as amended from time to time. No TA/DA is given for attending the interview. The notice does not state the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate – I posts has CSIR-CFTRI advertised?
faq.answer: CSIR-CFTRI has advertised 1 Project Associate – I (PAT-I) position under post code GAP000681. The notice says the number of vacancies may increase or decrease at the time of actual selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: The last date is 12.12.2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: An M.Sc in Food Science & Technology, Food Technology, Food Science, Food Science and Nutrition, Biotechnology or Biochemistry, OR a B.Tech in Food Technology, Biotechnology, Food Processing & Engineering or Food Engineering. The result must already be declared.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should not have exceeded 35 years as on 12.12.2026. The relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: Apply online only at https://patcell.cftri.res.in with the certificates supporting date of birth, caste and qualification/experience. No other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for this post?
faq.answer: A designated committee shortlists applicants and the shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. Selected candidates are declared on the CFTRI website based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project tenure or 06 years, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible to apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed a total of 6 years as Project Staff in any CSIR lab or institute are not eligible. Result awaited and final semester candidates are also not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Do current CSIR-CFTRI employees need permission to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate already working in CSIR/CSIR-CFTRI must submit a NOC from the current PI to apply for this project.
